name: compare/before-after-wipe
title: Before / after wipe
title_vi: Quét so sánh trước / sau bằng ảnh
desc_vi: Hai ảnh toàn khung: ảnh "trước" nằm dưới, ảnh "sau" quét lên từ mép trái một lượt, thanh chia và núm tròn hiện dần rồi dừng ở vị trí chia và giữ nguyên.
params_vi: before, after: đường dẫn ảnh trước / sau (rỗng = thẻ khung xương mặc định) · labelA, labelB: nhãn hai bên (rỗng = ẩn) · restSplit: vị trí dừng, % (50) · wipeAt: giây bắt đầu quét (0.25) · accent: màu núm và nhãn bên sau · exit: none | fade | up · duration: độ dài gốc 4 s · bg, fg, surface, border, muted: màu
notes: Layout, colours, sizes, envelope and eases as in the source (full-bleed panels with the default wireframe card 56 cqw x 56 cqh, label chips, divider 0.4 cqw with a round handle of min(5 cqw, 7 cqh) and an accent ring; stage 0.32 s power2.out, wipe 1.05 s sine.inOut starting at wipeAt (0.25 s), divider and handle fading in over 0.22 s power1.out as the wipe starts, optional exit fade / up (-6 cqh) 0.5 s power2.in at duration - 0.5 s; the phases shrink together when the duration is short). cqw / cqh are taken from the target box. The wipe was one CSS custom property (--baw-split) driving a clip-path calc and the divider's left; it is now two tweens with the same ease and time: the after panel's clip-path inset (100 % -> 100 - restSplit %) and the divider's x (0 -> restSplit % of the box), so the film holds plain keyframes. The two content slots are the params before / after (a picture path, covered edge to edge); the default empty value draws the source's token-styled wireframe card (muted grid on the before layer, accent-tinted gradient on the after layer); the gallery demo passes two neutral generated dashboard pictures (demo-assets flow-before.png / flow-after.png). The source also accepted a video or HTML in a slot: not ported (pictures only). accent is a hex colour (source: green / blue / violet reading theme tokens) and also the brand tint of the default after card (source: --brand, same colour in the default theme); theme tokens became params with the source fallbacks (bg #07111f, fg #f8fafc, surface #172033, border #334155, muted #94a3b8). The divider handle (::after) is a real child span; the hf:sfx 'wipe-land-soft' event is dropped (no audio in the kit). Chips are upper-cased in code (source: text-transform) and Vietnamese by default (source: Before / After); an empty label hides its chip. Font: the film's font instead of Inter. The root takes the radius of its target (border-radius: inherit).
